test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 05
subject: general
question:
Question Stimulus :­

A + B means that A is the husband of B

A > B means that A is the sister of B

A = B means that A is the father of B 

A -­ B means that A is the mother of B 

If the relationship between P and T is represented as P = Q > R -­ S + T, then, which of the following statements will be always TRUE?

options.text: Q is the father of S.
T is the grandson of P.
S is the son of Q.
T is the daughter ­in ­law of R.

solution:
The above given information can be shown using family tree using following symbols:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/27a142e4fbc5c1408a8a3bdbefef01f34767da81158398cba82cdc2ecc137710.png] 

and,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/42956ee3e51b294bbe841883a997616ed7ac999257875f67d1f195223d806ecc.png] 

Family tree,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea7e51fc782ed2d40d3d991686e3b649cd4fca605980a233ab7d6f49bf9aae0b.png] 

Hence, **"T is the daughter ­in ­law of R"** will be true for P = Q > R -­ S + T.
